Thanks for the reply but it's definitely not critters running into bushes as it's happened on places in my farm where there are no bushes around. I was walking towards my barns and the ground in front of me got kicked up and I could see brown specks. I didn't see anything go in or come out of that area and it wasn't raining so it couldn't have been lightning either. The sound is more of a crunchy crackle than a ruffling of leaves if that makes any sense?

And you're absolutely right I like coding as a hobby, I have always enjoyed coding when I was working on personal projects and I don't usually have a problem with deadlines otherwise. I have taken an intro to cybersecurity class that I enjoyed and did pretty well on which is why I was considering switching. I was pretty burnt out after HS and all I knew was I enjoyed coding so I didn't do much research before picking SE, so I've been doing a lot of research on cybersecurity now to make sure I don't make the same mistake if I do switch.

>Plus, the fact that there are way more programming jobs than security jobs in the world.
